objective: Create a private Hermes WebUI derived repository retaining upstream history; implement and verify a unified UI for four engines/six isolated nodes, automatic space routing, controlled per-engine learning, role permissions and remote WeKnora assets.

user_requirements.user_text: 多节点多引擎是可以隔离的，但是是统一入口访问，统一UI管理的
user_requirements.current: Sandbox node isolation verified; unified access/health/Runs only with runtime patch
user_requirements.target: One login/URL; engine-aware route; real node health, sessions, assets and Runs; explicit independent state and credentials

user_requirements.user_text: 多个引擎之间是否能够根据一定的规则和分析自动选择对应的空间
user_requirements.current: Manual UI profile selection; September trusted repo mapping only
user_requirements.target: Authorize scope first; instance/explicit rules then classifier; uncertainty asks rather than defaulting; bind engine/KB/Skill version/server node route

user_requirements.user_text: 当前方案各自节点的知识自进化是否隔离
user_requirements.current: Separate writable homes; governance tested with manual synthetic candidates; real learning quality NOT_RUN
user_requirements.target: Private node/case drafts; per-engine candidate/evaluation/review/release; same-engine approved assets shared; no cross-engine automatic writeback

user_requirements.user_text: 是否支持多个用户登录，给不同的访问权限
user_requirements.clarification: 权限管理主要是想管理部分人可以修改配置查看更多信息，部分人只能只读，部分人可以回消息问问题
user_requirements.current: One shared operator password; custom aggregate endpoints do not filter by user
user_requirements.target: Distinct users, server-side Admin/Viewer/Chat roles and field-level visibility; scopes optional policy but no unauthorized profile expansion

user_requirements.user_text: 多引擎是否支持多节点或者多进程部署
user_requirements.current: Six actual Gateway processes on one host; two Cassandra and two Redis nodes verified
user_requirements.target: Support one/multiple processes or nodes per engine, remote targets; state/ports/keys separate; pool selection under single Manager authority

user_requirements.user_text: 是否支持知识库或者skill这些直接对接到weknora的知识库，包括读取和使用，更新直接用远端的，是否支持版本管理，本地是否还需要保存
user_requirements.current: September real WeKnora reads plus separate release adapter; new WebUI has local-only asset panes
user_requirements.target: Remote WeKnora is authoritative; API/MCP knowledge consumption; remote Skill provider/package consumption; versioned publish+adoption; local approved snapshot/cache only when runtime needs it; private session state separate

architecture.business_authority: Existing internal Manager through ManagerClient; inaccessible deployment marked UNKNOWN. Do not default to replacing it with Paperclip or adding a competing task scheduler.
architecture.runtime: Engine -> pool -> explicit node -> isolated Hermes state
architecture.assets: WeKnora remote assets plus ONE version/release authority; node private drafts are not global approved assets

authorization.this_turn: Persist evidence, new requirements, execution contract and next-session prompt only
authorization.next_session: Create private derived repo, modify code, run bounded local real-component/synthetic-data verification, create test users and separate owned services, commit/push new fork privately once verified
not_authorized: Overwriting unrelated dirty work or old experiment evidence

fork_destination.method: Independent private history-preserving derived repo with upstream remote, because public GitHub forks cannot simply be private
fork_destination.if_existing: Inspect ownership/status/remotes and preserve; never overwrite or reset; choose an isolated new path if conflicting

implementation_constraints: Replace prototype monkeypatch with explicit maintained backend modules/hooks in fork
Do not mount all node Homes into central UI
Ordinary users never receive node admin keys; trusted proxy headers stripped/reissued by proxy
Keep model-fixture functional tests distinct from real classification/learning quality
One business Run state authority, one approved asset release authority
Preserve FAIL/NOT_RUN and scoped internal UNKNOWN
